title: Caregiver, resident 88: can't say words, right arm limp

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sunset Care Home, 2650 Great Highway, room 12. I'm her caregiver.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Tell me exactly what happened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mrs. Lee is 88. She understands me, she nods, but she can't say any words. Nothing comes out.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Her right arm is limp, she can't hold her cup with it at all.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was she last seen completely normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She was fine at breakfast. She ate and chatted with everyone.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Does she take any blood thinners?

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Stay with her.
